titel: Click Cuts, galerijbeeld 'Pins that fit your printer' op Superhive (proefblokje met vier spelingen)
rol: You make or download 3D models and print them at home, but many models are bigger than your printer bed. You are browsing the Superhive (Blender Market) store for a Blender add-on that cuts a model into parts that fit your printer and go back together. You worry that the connectors will be too loose or too tight on your printer. You are now looking at the gallery images on the product pages.

concurrenten.naam: SnapSplit (galerij: eigen verbinders op het snijvlak)
